title: GIG-3189: Prefer Newest Versioned Pg Dump Binary
description: Resolves pg_dump from /usr/lib/postgresql/{N}/bin (newest N) so produce does not follow Debian's pg_wrapper when an older client is also installed.

test_plan.description: PostgresDumpBinary picks the newest versioned path
steps: Confirm a tree with 16 and 17 clients resolves to 17
Confirm the generated workflow prepends /usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin to PATH
